concept.title: Modifying the QuayRegistry CR after deployment
concept.shortdesc: Modifying the QuayRegistry custom resource (CR) in Red Hat Quay after deployment lets you customize or reconfigure aspects of your Red Hat Quay environment.

conbody.p: Red Hat Quay administrators might modify the QuayRegistry CR for the following reasons:

ul.li: To change component management: Switch components from managed: true to managed: false in order to bring your own infrastructure. For example, you might set kind: objectstorage to unmanaged to integrate external object storage platforms such as Google Cloud Storage or Nutanix.
To apply custom configuration: Update or replace the configBundleSecret to apply new configuration settings, for example, authentication providers, external SSL/TLS settings, feature flags.
To enable or disable features: Toggle features like repository mirroring, Clair scanning, or horizontal pod autoscaling by modifying the spec.components list.
To scale the deployment: Adjust environment variables or replica counts for the Quay application.
To integrate with external services: Provide configuration for external PostgreSQL, Redis, or Clair databases, and update endpoints or credentials.
